MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

2. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 12.5

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 23

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

5. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 8
   D. 64

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

14. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 22
   C. 88
   D. 38

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

19. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

20. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 33
   C. 14
   D. 22

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 45
   D. 36

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

24. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 20

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

26. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

27. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 10

28. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 17
   D. 5

29. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

30. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

36. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
